description: D74 follow-up: treatment, strengthened. priority_coef 0.5->2.0, priority_high (elevation) 3.0->5.0, plus a new decaying per-slot occupancy term (occupancy_coef=0.3, occupancy_decay_cap=6.0 fair-share units, priority_reward_bonus in env.py) added alongside the discovery term -- not instead of it, and not touching REWARDS/reward_balance. Occupancy decays with cumulative visit_density (D55's own anti-camping anchor), not a resettable streak, so it stays clear of D53's camping exploit (verified directly: tests/test_band_priority.py's ping-pong-vs-sweep check). LSTM hidden size doubled 256->512 (policy_kwargs), timesteps doubled 400k->800k, both to test whether D74's null result was a capacity/budget limitation rather than the mechanism itself. Paired against lstm_balance_v2p_uniform_strong_seed2 (control) -- identical except priority_uniform=True. Mirrors D74's own seed (2) and base hyperparameters (ent_coef, gamma, n_steps).
